title: Alternative solution for determination of grade
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: An existing two-storey house is on a steep hill with about 7 m elevation change to the street. A new structure built into the slope contains a lower storage garage, living space above and a roof deck; an enclosed atrium connects it to the existing house.

The appellant proposed treating a horizontal roof-deck slab as an alternative to a vertical fire separation to determine building height; the local authority said the proposed alternative targeted a Division A method rather than a Division B acceptable solution.
The official page embeds a case-specific section drawing labelled with the dwelling, atrium, elevator, garage, living space, fire-separated assemblies and dimensions.
